_readme: What the mascot says, and when it celebrates. Edit freely: {count}, {days} and {book} are filled in. A message picks a mood (cheering, waving, reading, gentle) and the app shows the mascot image for that mood if one exists. Keep it warm, short, never preachy or guilt-y.

chapterDone.text: Lamp's a little brighter. Nice work!
That's one more. Proud of you!
You showed up today. That counts.

chapters.title: You've read {count} chapters!
chapters.text: Every one of them was a choice to show up. Keep the lamp burning.

chapters.title: You've read {count} chapters!
chapters.text: That's a lot of good words in your heart. On to the next.

streak.title: {days} days in a row!
streak.text: You've opened the Word {days} days running. That's a rhythm worth keeping.

streak.title: {days} days in a row!
streak.text: Small, steady, every day. Look at you go.

book.title: You finished {book}!
book.text: Start to end, every chapter. Take a second to enjoy that.

book.title: {book}: done!
book.text: A whole book of the Bible, read. What stayed with you?

welcomeBack.text: Welcome back, let's pick up where you left off.
Hey, good to see you. Your place is saved.
No catching up needed. Just today's chapter.

daily.text: One chapter is plenty. Let's light the lamp.
Grab a seat. Today's reading is waiting for you.
A few quiet minutes with the Word? I'll keep the light on.
Today's a good day to read something good.

readToday.text: Lamp's lit for today. Nice work!

emptyCircles.text: Reading's better with friends. Start a Circle and invite your first Lamplighter.

emptyCircle.text: It's just you so far. Invite your first Lamplighter!

signedOut.text: Circles keep you and your friends reading together. Sign in to start one.
